subject: Re: POC scope & success criteria — AcmeCorp (re-baseline requested)
messages:
From: Alison Wu <alison.wu@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (AcmeCorp)

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood today — very helpful. Quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can get the POC scheduled: 

Summary of what we heard:
- Goal: reduce customer support response latency by surfacing automated suggested replies and call routing hints (primary use case).
- Secondary: ingest recent chat logs to improve context-aware recommendations.
- Target latency SLA: 300ms p50 for suggestions during interactive sessions.

Success criteria we care about (initial):
1) 80% of suggested replies accepted by agents in the trial (measured over 2 weeks)
2) p50 latency < 300ms and p95 < 800ms for API calls from our staging region
3) No PII leakage in suggestions; pass our data handling checklist

Next asks from Acme: 
- Can you send a proposed evaluation plan + timeline (owners + milestones)?
- Please attach the current MOP/POC plan you referenced on the call.

I attached a short doc with our internal success-weighting that may shift scope slightly. We are aiming to start the POC the week of Dec 6, but need your confirmation on timeline.

Thanks — looking forward to the plan.

-Alison
Senior Product Manager, AcmeCorp

Attachments: acme_success_weights.xlsx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alison Wu <alison.wu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (AcmeCorp)

Hi Alison — great call, thanks for the clear recap and the success-weighting doc. Attaching our MOP (redwood_poc_mop_v1.pdf) and a concise evaluation plan below. Please see inline for owners and proposed timeline. Happy to adjust after you review.

Proposed evaluation plan (high level):
- Kickoff & access (Week 0 — Dec 6): data ingestion access, service account, test user provisioning (Owners: Marissa / Acme infra lead)
- Baseline run (Week 1 — Dec 7–13): run existing model config on 2k sample conversations to capture baseline precision/latency (Owner: Camila)
- Iteration & tuning (Week 2 — Dec 14–20): apply batching/kv-cache settings and a lightweight prompt engineering pass (Owner: Camila)
- Acceptance window (Week 3 — Dec 21–Jan 3): live agent trial with 2 teams, capture acceptance rate & latency metrics (Owners: Acme product + Redwood CS)
- Wrap & recommendation (Week 4 — Jan 4–8): final report and next-step recommendations (Owner: Marissa)

Success criteria (as proposed, aligned to your list):
- Agent acceptance rate >= 80% over the acceptance window
- p50 latency < 300ms; p95 < 800ms for calls from Acme staging region
- No classified PII surfaced in suggestions (we will run sample audits)

Open items / risks:
- We will need a clear set of sample conversations and a staging endpoint in your infra.
- If you plan to run additional use cases (e.g., extraction / structured outputs) during the trial, that will likely require additional mapping work and may shift timeline by ~1–2 weeks.

Next steps:
1) Marissa: finalize MOP (attached) — please confirm access needs by Mon Nov 23
2) Alison: share staging endpoint + sample dataset by Wed Nov 25
3) Camila: prep baseline script and sampling plan by Nov 30

If this looks good, we can lock the Dec 6 kickoff.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_poc_mop_v1.pdf

From: Alison Wu <alison.wu@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (AcmeCorp)

Thanks Marissa — this looks good. One change request from our side: during the trial we want to add a focused extraction use case (pulling structured fields from chat transcripts for CRM autofill). That was not in the original primary scope.

Impact from our perspective:
- This is lower priority than the assistant suggestion flow, but we'd like to validate feasibility in the POC.
- We expect ~500 extraction examples per day during the acceptance window.

Can Redwood accommodate adding the extraction pipeline as an add-on to the POC? If so, please provide an updated plan and any timeline impacts. I attached an addendum that outlines the extraction mapping we have in mind.

Thanks — Ben (our engineering lead) is looped and can provide the sample mapping if needed.

-Alison

Attachment: acme_usecase_addendum.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Re: Discovery recap + next steps (AcmeCorp) — extraction add-on (internal)

Camila / Rishi — forwarding Acme's addendum (they attached mapping doc). Quick internal thoughts:
- Extraction adds a structured inference pipeline and modest preprocessing to map transcripts -> fields. We can prototype with the same model family but will need an extra mapper and a validation harness.
- Estimated impact: +1 week to the iteration phase (to add mapper + validation), potential minor infra work for batched extraction throughput.
- Proposed revised timeline: kick remains Dec 6 but acceptance window shifts: 
  - Baseline: Dec 7–13
  - Iteration & extraction prototype: Dec 14–21 (one extra week)
  - Acceptance window: Dec 22–Jan 5 (extend to cover holiday overlap)

Requesting: Rishi — can you confirm we have capacity to spin up the validation harness and a small worker for extraction? Camila — please adjust baseline script to include a small extraction sample and update test harness.

If we proceed, I will propose a re-baselined MOP to Acme that includes new success criteria for extraction (accuracy & field-level recall).

-M

- Kick: Dec 6
- Baseline: Dec 7–13
- Iteration & extraction prototype: Dec 14–23 (extended for integration & QA)
- Acceptance window: Dec 24–Jan 7
- Final report: Jan 8–12

I recommend we call this a re-baseline and share a short change note with Acme outlining the scope addition, timeline shift (+~1 week), and new success metric for extraction: field-level recall >= 85% on the sample set.

-Camila
